question: What goes into your patty mixture?
answer: For the patty mixture, we start with butter. Then we add garlic and ginger paste, along with our other basic seasonings. We keep the base relatively simple because we want to maintain the original beef flavour. Because some customers prefer a slightly spicy patty, we add a controlled amount of red chilli according to the quantity of meat.

question: How heavy is each patty?
answer: Each chilled raw ball weighs 85-90 g. Classic Smash: 1 patty (85-90 g). Double Smash: 2 patties (170-180 g raw beef).

question: How hot should the griddle be for the smash?
answer: Heat a heavy flat cast-iron griddle to 220-240°C until light wisps of smoke appear. Place the cold 85-90 g ball on the dry, un-oiled griddle and cover it with a small square of butter paper. Press with the heavy smash tool using full body weight for 10 seconds until paper-thin with lacy edges. Remove the paper and season immediately with fine salt and cracked black pepper. Sear side 1 undisturbed for 60-90 seconds until the edges are dark brown and crispy. Slide a stiff metal scraper fully under the crust and flip in one clean motion. Immediately lay a cheddar slice on the hot patty and cook side 2 for only 30-45 seconds until the cheese melts. Remove immediately. Never press the patty after flipping.

question: What goes into the burger sauce?
answer: For our burger sauce, we use mayonnaise, Dippit BBQ sauce, mustard sauce, Worcestershire sauce and tomato ketchup. Apart from barbecue sauce, we also use mustard sauce, rosemary sauce, chilli sauce, paprika powder, rosemary and black pepper. The brands make a big difference: if you use low-quality brands, the taste can change significantly.

question: Pickles kaise banate ho?
answer: Hum cucumber le kar usko properly slice karte hain. Phir around one cup hot water mein approximately 3-4 tablespoons vinegar, one small lemon, 2 tablespoons sugar aur half teaspoon salt add karte hain. Sliced cucumbers ko is mixture mein daal kar around 30 minutes ke liye chhor dete hain. Uske baad pickles ko isi liquid mein cool hone dete hain, aur jab woh cool ho jayein toh refrigerator mein store kar dete hain.

question: Burger assemble karne ki tarteeb kya hai?
answer: Neechay wali bun makhan mein taway par halki golden toast, phir signature sauce ki achhi layer, phir taaza khushk katti hui iceberg lettuce (bun ko geela hone se bachati hai), phir barabar phailay 3-4 pickle slices, phir cheesy patty (Classic ke liye 1; Double ke liye 2 stacked, cheese darmiyan mein), phir garam cheese ke upar caramelised pyaaz, aur aakhir mein makhan mein toast ki hui upar wali bun, andar sauce laga kar halka band karein.

question: Which cheese do you use for burgers?
answer: For our burgers, we use Adam's burger cheese. I personally prefer Adam's because I find its quality and melting consistency good. Usually, it takes around five minutes for the cheese to melt properly, depending on how we're preparing the burger. For our pasta, we also use Adam's cheddar cheese.

question: How do you make caramelised onions?
answer: Thinly sliced onions cooked slowly in pure butter over low flame for 35-45 minutes with a pinch of salt. Never rushed on high heat, never any sugar. Slow cooking lets the natural sugars break down and brown deeply.

question: Burger kis cheez mein wrap karte ho?
answer: Do materials: butter paper (roz ki wrapping) aur foil paper. Foil tab lagayein jab garmi zyada der rakhni ho, khaas tor par door ki delivery ya thand ke mausam mein.

question: How long do you boil the pasta?
answer: We usually boil the pasta for around 8-10 minutes, depending on the type and brand we are using.

question: Pasta sauce mein kya dalta hai?
answer: Pasta sauce ke liye hum cheddar cheese, specifically Adam's cheese, cream, milk aur butter use karte hain. Hum all-purpose milk bhi use karte hain. Ingredients ki quality bohat important hai kyun ke brand change karne ya lower-quality product use karne se pasta ka taste aur consistency affect ho sakti hai.

question: Which pasta brand and shape do you use?
answer: Exclusively Penne from Bake Parlour or Regia. The tubular, ridged shape holds thick cream sauce outside and traps cheese inside. Both brands survive high-heat tossing without breaking or turning mushy.

question: How do you marinate the chicken?
answer: For the marinade, we use Shan Chicken Tikka Powder, along with chicken powder, chilli sauce, soy sauce, black pepper, a little salt, chilli flakes, and oregano. Depending on what we're preparing, we also use different seasoning mixes, sometimes Rosemary products or Falak products.

question: Chicken kitni der saute karni hai?
answer: Boneless chicken breast ke chhote cubes, garam pan mein thode makhan/oil ke saath medium-high aanch par 5-7 minute saute karein taake golden aur juicy rahe. Alag rakh lein.

question: What do you do with the pasta water?
answer: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil and salt it generously (it should taste seasoned). Check 1 minute before the packet time: tender outside, firm white core. Drain and reserve half a cup of starchy pasta water. Never rinse with cold tap water.

question: How long does a burger and pasta combo take?
answer: Classic or Double Smash: 6-8 minutes (1 min bun toast, 2 min sear and melt, 2 min build, 1 min wrap). Alfredo Penne: 10-12 minutes (4 min chicken, 4 min sauce and toss, 2 min boxing). Burger + Pasta combo: 12-15 minutes, running the griddle and pasta pan at the same time.

question: Patty fry karte waqt toot rahi hai, kya karun?
answer: Agar patty fry karte waqt toot rahi hai: Do cheezein check karein: patty mixture mein zyada butter, ya zyada raw papaya paste. Papaya paste zyada ho jaye toh mixture water release karta hai, aur is excess moisture se patty weak ho kar frying ke waqt toot jati hai. Humein ye exact problem Habitt stall par face hui thi.

question: My burger came out dry
answer: If burger patty came out dry: Causes: (1) mince under 20% fat; (2) griddle too cold (below 200°C) so juices stew out instead of searing; (3) patty pressed after flipping. Fix: verify 80/20, heat the griddle to 220°C+ before the meat goes on, and smash once for 10 seconds, never again.

question: Alfredo sauce patli reh gayi hai
answer: Agar Alfredo sauce patli ya watery reh gayi: Medium-low aanch par 1-2 minute mazeed pakayein aur 2 chamach cheese daalein. Phir bhi patli ho to aadha chamach cornflour thande doodh mein ghol kar daalein aur 1 minute chalayein.

question: The sauce split and looks oily
answer: If Alfredo sauce split, curdled or oily: The pan got too hot and the dairy fat separated. Remove from the flame immediately and whisk in 2 tablespoons of warm starchy pasta water or cold milk vigorously; the sauce re-emulsifies within about 30 seconds.

question: The bun gets soggy before delivery
answer: If bottom bun gets soggy before delivery: Toast the cut side in butter until a solid golden crust forms. Lay the shredded iceberg directly over the sauce before the hot patty; it shields the bun from steam and drippings. With foil, don't wrap airtight while blazing hot: let steam escape for 20 seconds first, or wrap in butter paper and then foil.
